acceptanceCriteria: A measurement on a >=8k receipt store shows whether non-publishing refreshes recur per write.
If confirmed: backoff or reason trace with a regression test; if not, close with the evidence.
body: Inferred from code by the V1-1650 lane (PR #1075), not measured: once head is >=512 past FullSeq every writer-route write schedules a full refresh after unlock; a refresh that publishes nothing (intent-only divergence, cleanup, unsettled move, lock failure, supersession, newer checkpoint) leaves FullSeq behind, so the next write pays again until the 4096 bound. Expected: bounded backoff or a recorded reason so persistent non-publication does not reintroduce per-write full audits (the #1072 symptom).
title: suspected: refreshWriterCheckpoint can re-run a complete audit on every write when a refresh publishes nothing
